cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The tent fell exactly where our story turns. I mentioned that loose peg and told you to keep your waterproof coat nearby.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were supposed to fix the peg, not make a story out of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'd lose the warning. Please note the peg before we rebuild; the recovery only makes sense if we keep the cause.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can the recovery start now? I'm getting soaked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put on the coat I told you to keep ready. Fasten it before helping with the pole, please; that earlier instruction is what gets us through this part.

reason: Both early details are prepared; B's actual wetness leads A to use the coat as the planned recovery cue while supervising rebuilding.
